# Illusive Studio

> Independent creative studio operated by Ian Lester Eclevia — a Digital Art Director and Frontend Developer based in Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines. Illusive Studio offers an end-to-end production pipeline that bridges premium aesthetic design, technical execution, and algorithmic strategy.

## About

- **Operator:** Ian Lester Eclevia
- **Studio:** Illusive Studio (also known as "The Illusive Lab")
- **Location:** Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines
- **Contact:** yhanlhester@gmail.com
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/BogartPagalpok
- **Live site:** https://illusivestudio.vercel.app/

## Services

- **Frontend Engineering** — Production-grade web apps in React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Mobile-first, performance-tuned, PWA-ready.
- **UI / UX Design** — Interface systems, design tokens, prototyping, and component libraries.
- **Brand Identity** — Logo systems, type pairings, color systems, brand guidelines.
- **Digital Art Direction** — Advanced compositing in Photoshop, AI-augmented art direction (Midjourney workflows), digital painting.
- **High-Retention Video Editing** — Short-form vertical content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), Same-Day Edits (SDE), commercial compositing for YouTube algorithms.
- **Photography** — Editorial, portrait, and product photography with full post-production.
- **Virtual Assistance** — Organized creative-operations support, design pipeline management.

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend:** React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js
- **Backend / Data:** Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage), Vercel
- **Creative:** Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Midjourney, Canva Pro
- **Workflow:** Custom AI tooling for SEO content generation, mobile-first design systems
